# Image Enhancer

Image enhancer: sharpen and restore a blurry, noisy or old photo from your MegaScenes library, with cleaner detail, less grain and restored faces, at a higher resolution.

## What it does
Pick a photo from your MegaScenes library. Claude tells you the price and returns a sharper, cleaner version at a higher resolution.

**How the files are made:** each enhanced image is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Starts from an image in your MegaScenes library: files attached in the chat are not passed to the plugin.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install image-enhancer@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Image Enhancer talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/image-enhancer/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each enhanced image uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The enhanced images show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_enhanced_image_models` | Models for enhanced images with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_enhanced_image_cost` | Exact price of one enhanced image before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_enhanced_image` | Starts one enhanced image in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_enhanced_image` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_my_images` | Your uploads and images made here, to pick the one to start from. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Enhance my latest MegaScenes photo"
- "Fix the blur in my last photo"
- "Restore my old family photo from my library"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the enhanced image (the photo you pick from your library) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
